title: Made for playing together
description: We're a Cape Town video game studio making high-energy games that are easy to pick up, hard to put down, and best played with friends.
paragraphs: Hyrax Studios was founded by a small group of classmates in our already small classrooms. We were initially credited under Rookie Games and debuted our first public prototype GET RAMMED at Playtopia 2025, originally developed for an 8-hour game jam. It is now our first full release, out on Steam!
